outcome.Summary: Extended package config: added `Timeout time.Duration` (env APP_TIMEOUT via time.ParseDuration, default 30s in Defaults) and `Tags []string` (env APP_TAGS, comma-split, trimmed, empty items dropped, nil default); added `Merge(base, override Config) Config` where each non-zero override field replaces base and a non-nil Tags slice replaces base even when empty, without mutating the arguments' slices; rewrote `Load` to collect all invalid env values (APP_PORT, APP_DEBUG, APP_WORKERS, APP_TIMEOUT) and return them joined via `errors.Join` along with the zero Config. Verified with `go test -count=1 -v ./...` — all 11 tests (existing behavior preserved plus new cases) pass and `go vet` is clean.
